description: mta_sts_dns.rs: MtaStsTxtRecord derives Debug but not Clone. relay_client.rs:181 passes &txt to load_fresh_policy which takes &MtaStsTxtRecord — fine. But any caller wanting to retain the record must move it. Since MtaStsTxtRecord only contains a String, deriving Clone is trivially correct and adds flexibility for callers who need to retain a copy alongside the returned policy. Add #[derive(Clone)].
title: MtaStsTxtRecord does not derive Clone — requires ownership transfer in callers
